question: According to the 2011 Census of India, the decadal growth rate of India was around:
solution:
The correct answer is __**17.7%.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the provisional reports released on 31 March 2011,** the Indian population increased to 1.21 billion with a decadal growth of 17.70%.**
 
• **The adult literacy rate increased to 74.04% with a decadal growth of 9.21%.**
 
• The** motto of the census was 'Our Census, Our future'.**
 
• The 2011 Census of India or the 15th Indian Census was conducted in two phases:
 
 
• House listing.
 
• Population enumeration.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
